text.en: 1. This Notification is the Education (Exemptions of Religious Schools from Act) Notification 1989.

2. The Minister for Education, having been satisfied that the teaching in the schools set out in the Schedule is of a purely religious character, has exempted those schools and the managers and teachers thereof from the provisions of the Act, with effect from the dates shown against their respective names.
